query:
SELECT
            u.id AS "id: UserId",
            u.username,
            u.first_name,
            u.last_name,
            u.guild_rank AS "guild_rank: Rank",
            u.is_superuser,
            (u.disabled_at IS NOT NULL) AS "disabled!",
            COALESCE(
                (SELECT jsonb_agg(
                     jsonb_build_object(
                         'first_name', ch.first_name,
                         'last_name', ch.last_name,
                         'class', ch.class,
                         'level', ch.level,
                         'is_main', ch.is_main,
                         'in_guild', in_guild(ch.guild)
                     ) ORDER BY ch.is_main DESC, in_guild(ch.guild) DESC, ch.level DESC, ch.name_normalized
                 )
                 FROM characters ch
                 WHERE ch.user_id = u.id),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ) AS "characters!: sqlx::types::Json<Vec<AccountCharacter>>",
            COALESCE(
                (SELECT jsonb_agg(
                     jsonb_build_object(
                         'provider', p.slug,
                         'provider_name', p.name,
                         'subject', c.subject,
                         'userinfo', c.raw_userinfo,
                         'disconnected_at', c.disconnected_at
                     ) ORDER BY c.disconnected_at NULLS FIRST, p.name
                 )
                 FROM auth_oauth2_provider_credentials c
                 JOIN auth_providers p ON p.id = c.provider_id
                 WHERE c.user_id = u.id),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ) AS "connections!: sqlx::types::Json<Vec<RawConnection>>",
            u.created_at
        FROM users u
        ORDER BY u.username_normalized
